geometry_evidence_or_assumptions: Conditional CAD body-radius endpoint; pitch radius unmeasured; coaxial open-belt carrier and 50/50 shoulder split assumed; see docs/thor-elbow-mechanism.md and docs/thor-elbow-loads.md

belt_tension_requirement.span_convention: T_plus minus T_minus, positive resultant produces positive q3 torque
belt_tension_requirement.meaning: Magnitude is tight minus slack; clamp, wrap and bearing forces unresolved

caveats: Radii, signs and carrier mapping are inputs; no calibrated motion instruction
Static demands exclude motion, friction, acceleration, cables and thermal effects
No physical shoulder load-sharing fraction is guaranteed
No efficiency multiplier is applied to zero-power static holding
Tension difference does not establish pretension, traction, clamp or bearing capacity
